idea-plugin.name: Pi Terminal Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Terminal Bridge

Persistent Pi coding agent sessions for JetBrains IDEs — launch, track and resume conversations, with a live bridge between the IDE and the pi terminal. The Pi tab is a real terminal running the full pi TUI. Send code context from the editor, pick a model, optionally open files Pi edited.

Important: Install the Pi CLI separately before using this plugin.
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent or visit pi.dev

Features

  • Persistent conversations — sessions survive IDE restarts; click to relaunch and resume. Terminals are not auto-revived on startup.
  • Live bridge — working/idle badges, current model, and session switches (/new, /fork, /resume) reflected in the IDE panel in real time; old sessions archived and resumable
  • One-click launch from the toolbar in a dedicated Terminal tab
  • Send to Pi — select code, right-click, and send a file reference (@path/file.go#L10-25) to Pi's input. The panel input also has a context menu and accepts files dropped from the Project view.
  • Notifications — optional balloon when the agent finishes (only while the IDE is in the background; click to focus that terminal); optionally open files Pi edited
  • Flexible configuration for models, thinking levels, and launch options

Quick start

  1. Click the pi button in the main toolbar (or press Ctrl+Shift+P).
  2. A new Pi tab opens in the Terminal window and runs pi automatically.
  3. Select code, right-click, then Send to Pi to add file context to your prompt.
  4. Close and reopen the IDE — conversations are listed in the Pi panel and resume on click.

Open Settings → Tools → Pi Terminal Bridge to pick the model, thinking level, launch options, and bridge features.

Keyboard shortcuts

  • Ctrl+Shift+P — Open the Pi conversation window
  • Alt+Shift+3 — Send selection / file to Pi

Both are rebindable in Settings → Keymap → Pi Terminal Bridge.

Supported IDEs

Works with all JetBrains IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, and more.

Pi Terminal Bridge（pi 终端桥）

为 JetBrains IDE 提供 Pi coding agent 的持久会话 —— 启动、跟踪与恢复会话，并在 IDE 与 pi 终端之间维持一条实时通道。Pi 标签页是真实终端里跑着完整的 pi TUI。可从编辑器发送代码上下文、选择模型，也可选在 Pi 改文件后自动打开。

前置条件：使用本插件前请单独安装 Pi CLI。
npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 或访问 pi.dev

功能

  • 持久会话 —— 会话跨 IDE 重启保留；点击即可重新拉起并恢复。启动时不会批量复活终端。
  • 实时桥接 —— working/idle 徽标、当前模型，以及终端内 /new、/fork、/resume 换绑都会同步到 IDE 面板；旧会话归档后仍可恢复
  • 一键启动 —— 工具栏按钮在 Terminal 工具窗中打开专属 Pi 标签页
  • 发送到 Pi —— 选中代码，右键发送文件引用（@path/file.go#L10-25）到 Pi 输入栏。面板输入栏也有右键菜单，并接受从 Project 视图拖入的文件。
  • 通知 —— 可选：agent 结束时气泡提醒（仅 IDE 在后台时弹出；点击可定位到对应终端）；可选打开 Pi 改过的文件
  • 灵活配置 —— 模型、thinking 级别与启动参数

快速上手

  1. 点击主工具栏的 pi 按钮（或按 Ctrl+Shift+P）。
  2. Terminal 工具窗中打开专属 Pi 标签页，自动运行 pi。
  3. 选中代码，右键 → Send to Pi，把文件上下文加入提示。
  4. 关闭并重开 IDE —— 面板中列出全部会话，点击即可恢复。

打开 Settings → Tools → Pi Terminal Bridge 可选择模型、thinking 级别、启动选项和桥接功能。

快捷键

  • Ctrl+Shift+P —— 打开 Pi 会话窗口
  • Alt+Shift+3 —— 发送选中内容 / 文件到 Pi

均可在 Settings → Keymap → Pi Terminal Bridge 中修改。

支持的 IDE

适用于所有 JetBrains IDE：IntelliJ IDEA、GoLand、PyCharm、WebStorm、PhpStorm、CLion、Rider、RubyMine 等。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.2

  • Finish notifications fire only when the IDE is in the background; click the balloon to focus that terminal
  • Status bar shows how many conversations are working
  • Panel input: context menu and drag-and-drop files as @path refs
  • Clear warnings when Extra arguments conflict with session flags, or when the Windows Terminal shell is cmd.exe
  • Tool window / notification group renamed to Pi Bridge
  • Fix: restore-terminal no longer calls Terminal getShellPath on the EDT

0.3.1

  • New identity: renamed to Pi Terminal Bridge (com.piterminal.bridge); fresh start, earlier 0.x releases belong to the original pi-agent-launcher project
  • Persistent conversations: sessions survive IDE restarts, click to relaunch and resume
  • Live IDEA-pi bridge: working/idle badges, model display, session rebind on /new//fork with old session archived
  • Settings: agent-finish notifications and auto-open modified files (both opt-in)
